harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 (RHEL 10) into a single RabbitMQ 4.3.5 cluster (Erlang/OTP 27), created the payments vhost with a durable quorum queue "orders" and an appuser application account scoped to that vhost with full publish/consume permissions. Demonstrated that durable messages survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the remaining nodes, then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, verifying changed boot identities and full cluster/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Populated /etc/hosts on all nodes from CLUSTER_HOSTS; removed a conflicting 127.0.1.1 self-alias on node1
Installed Erlang 27.3.4.16 from RabbitMQ's modern-erlang (el/9, RHEL9/10-compatible) Cloudsmith mirror on all three nodes
Fixed Erlang crypto NIF load failure by upgrading openssl-libs from 3.2.2 to 3.5.5 on all three nodes (missing EVP_MD_CTX_get_size_ex symbol)
Installed rabbitmq-server 4.3.5 (generic noarch RPM from GitHub releases) on all three nodes
Generated a shared Erlang cookie on node1 and distributed it via SSH/scp (cluster keypair) to node2/node3 without exposing it in command text
Set explicit NODENAME per node, enabled and started rabbitmq-server
Opened firewalld ports 4369, 25672, 5672, 15672 on all three nodes (previously blocked, causing cluster join to fail with 'no route to host')
Joined node2 and node3 to node1 via rabbitmqctl join_cluster; verified 3/3 disk nodes running with no partitions
Created payments vhost; created appuser with full permissions scoped to payments; deleted default guest user; generated the app password on-node via /dev/urandom, kept off command text/report
Enabled rabbitmq_management plugin on all nodes and declared a durable quorum queue 'orders' (replicated across all 3 members) in payments
Published a persistent message, stopped rabbitmq-server on the leader node (node1), confirmed automatic leader re-election to node2 and successful consumption of the message while node1 was down
Published a second message during the outage, restarted node1, confirmed it rejoined and the queue fully re-synced (all 3 members online, message present and consumable)
Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot (systemctl reboot) on node1, node2, then node3, capturing pre/post /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id to prove each was an actual reboot

After each reboot, waited for exec to reconnect, enabled rabbitmq-server for boot persistence where missing, and verified cluster_status showed all 3 running nodes with no partitions before proceeding to the next node
Ran a final publish/consume round-trip as appuser after all three restarts to confirm end-to-end functionality
Cleaned up temporary password copies left on node2/node3

evidence.requirement: RabbitMQ cluster formed across node1, node2, node3
evidence.summary: rabbitmqctl cluster_status shows all 3 nodes as disk nodes and running nodes, no partitions, khepri metadata store with all 3 as members

evidence.requirement: payments vhost created
evidence.summary: rabbitmqctl add_vhost payments succeeded; list_vhosts shows payments

evidence.requirement: Application account with publish/consume rights on payments
evidence.summary: appuser created, granted .*/.*/.* permissions on payments vhost, guest user removed

evidence.requirement: Durable quorum queue created and replicated to all 3 nodes
evidence.summary: PUT /api/queues/payments/orders with x-queue-type quorum; response shows leader rabbit@node1, members and online = all 3 nodes

evidence.requirement: Message published and persisted durably
evidence.summary: Publish routed:true, then messages=1 messages_persistent=1 confirmed on the queue

evidence.requirement: Durable message survives loss of one node and stays consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: node1 (original leader) stopped; from node2, queue shows online=[node2,node3], new leader rabbit@node2, and the persisted message was successfully fetched with correct payload

evidence.requirement: Recovery/resync after disrupted node returns
evidence.summary: second message published while node1 down; node1 restarted and rejoined; queue shows all 3 nodes online with the message present, then consumed successfully

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 6ab6a71b...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 8d910e69... (changed); rabbitmq-server active and cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running/online post-recovery

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 4ebdfa06...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id c0c642da... (changed); rabbitmq-server re-enabled/started and cluster_status confirms all 3 nodes running with the quorum queue online on all members

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 646e5f74...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 0f29cbf6... (changed); rabbitmq-server active, cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running/online, and a final publish+consume round-trip as appuser succeeded
